title: Rig Work-Stream Event
description: Append-only work-stream event record. Each line in a work-stream JSONL log must validate against one of the defined event types. NOTE: 'work-stream' is a legacy term for worktree normalization events; this schema remains for backward compatibility.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event (UUID or deterministic slug).

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the event was recorded.

worker.description: Name or slug of the agent or process that appended this event.

old_path.description: Absolute path of the worktree before the move.

new_path.description: Absolute path of the worktree after the move.

branch.description: Branch checked out in this worktree at move time.

head.description: Short or full commit SHA of HEAD at move time.

old_path.description: Absolute path of the worktree that was not moved.

reason.description: Human-readable reason the move was skipped or refused.

branch.description: Branch checked out in this worktree.

head.description: Short or full commit SHA of HEAD at check time.
